country.match: Match each racetrack to its country.
country.odd: Three of these racetracks are in {value}. Which one isn't?
country.reverse: Which of these racetracks is in {value}?

exclude.why: Circuit de Monaco: label shares the word Monaco with the answer

rows.label: Sepang International Circuit
rows.hook: hosted Formula One races for nearly two decades, near a big airport in Southeast Asia

rows.label: Monza Circuit
rows.hook: is a fast, historic track north of Milan and a fixture of the Formula One calendar since its earliest seasons

rows.label: Nürburgring
rows.description: race track in Nürburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
rows.hook: has a punishing northern loop in the Eifel mountains that Jackie Stewart nicknamed the Green Hell

rows.label: Baku City Circuit
rows.description: motor racing circuit in Baku, Azerbaijan.
rows.hook: is a Formula One city track by a seaside boulevard, with one of the longest laps on the calendar

rows.label: Silverstone Circuit
rows.description: motor racing circuit on the Buckinghamshire and Northamptonshire border, UK
rows.hook: hosted the very first race of the Formula One world championship and still stages its nation's grand prix

rows.label: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca
rows.description: motorsport track in the United States

rows.label: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
rows.hook: is a Formula One track seen as an all-rounder, with long straights and a mix of corners

rows.label: Bristol Motor Speedway
rows.description: motorsport track in the United States
rows.hook: is a half-mile oval where NASCAR draws 146,000 fans and college football games have been played

rows.label: Indianapolis Motor Speedway
rows.description: motorsport track in Indianapolis, IN, USA
rows.hook: is the home of a legendary 500-mile race and the Brickyard 400 NASCAR event

rows.label: Marina Bay Street Circuit
rows.hook: is a harbourside track on city roads that stages a Formula One grand prix and nearly always sees a safety car

rows.label: Imola Circuit
rows.hook: is named after the founder of a famous Italian carmaker and his son

rows.label: Circuit of the Americas
rows.description: race track near Austin, Texas, USA
rows.hook: was the first track in its country purpose-built for Formula One, near the capital of Texas

rows.label: Darlington Raceway
rows.description: motorsport track in the United States

rows.label: Circuit de Monaco
rows.description: street circuit around the harbour of the principality of Monaco
rows.hook: winds around a harbour through a glitzy city's streets and is often simply called Monte Carlo
